facts.statement: The 2026-08-17 automatic CNINFO discovery still contains the 2025 annual report, 2026 Q1 report and 2025 dividend disclosure used by the R1 semantic work; no newer earnings release in the discovered set changes the R1 normalized-earnings conclusions.
A CNINFO disclosure dated 2026-08-01 is titled '关于高级管理人员被留置调查的公告'. The discovered primary-source metadata does not contain a final investigation conclusion.

A 2026-08-12 CNINFO disclosure reports progress on a bank-credit guarantee for Henan Xinhua Materials Group Co., Ltd.; it does not by itself evidence a change to the R1 normalized publishing/distribution economics.

interpretation: The refreshed primary set does not reopen the five completed D2 economic questions. The detention/investigation disclosure is, however, a distinct governance risk signal that should be monitored separately from the tax, working-capital and valuation gates.
judgment: D2 remains COMPLETE/HOLD with no decision promotion. Add a governance invalidation gate: reopen semantic underwriting if the investigation produces a material operating, accounting, internal-control or capital-allocation consequence.
